elements.name: loft-12 Create a solid Loft with a center-line sketch

steps.name: a disposable copy of the native fixture "fixtures/cad/loft/circles-center-line.opd" is open
the two circular sections and straight sketch between their centers are visible
both circular profiles are selected in Loft and Center Line mode is chosen
the dialog requests a center-line sketch and OK is disabled
the Center Line selector is activated and Sketch3 is shown as the selected center line
a solid preview appears and OK is enabled
Loft1 and Solid Bodies(1) appear in the browser
